text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Revolutionay Command Council grants civil servants a 50 percent salary increase. The increase will not be handed to them now. It will be saved for them in national banks for a year or until the end of trade sanctions.
- Some service persons belong to the American and Israeli intelligence have entered northern Iraq under the cover of working with Red Cross committees.
- Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz tells the CNN that U.N. chief arms inspector Rolf Ekeus has violated an agreement reached with him in June 1996.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- A delegation from the Russian parliament to visit Iraq soon.
- Indonesian medical exhibition will be opened in Baghdad on Tuesday.

- Iraqi Oil Minister Amir Muhammad Rasheed says in Vienna where he is attending an OPEC meeting that Iraq will be ready to export oil as soon as a food distribution plan under the oil-for-food deal with the U.N. is ready.
